design: Conditional on the fixed data generator, folds and hyperparameters of the paired time-split audit.
candidate_pairs: Outcome family first; take the Cartesian product in learner tie order.
observable_at_selection: At the start of block k+1, rank candidates using losses from completed block k. Use k=1,2 (zero-based). Outcome and treatment MSEs score that role on k. For R-loss, compute each candidate slope only on earlier contiguous out-of-fold rows before k. Score its frozen slope on k with one common pair of pre-k tree nuisance models. No block-k+1 outcome enters selection. Resolve ties by the listed order.
primary_endpoint: Squared error of the selected candidate's re-estimated scalar slope on block k+1 against the planted block-average structural effect. This is estimation accuracy for a later block after its outcomes mature.
secondary_endpoint: Squared error on the same truth of the selected candidate slope frozen using all scored dates before k+1.
uncertainty: Average both originating block differences within each simulation path before computing paired Monte Carlo standard errors against fixed_trees. Report all rules and regimes. Intervals are descriptive, pointwise 1.96-MCSE summaries.
scope: Confirm whether the retrospective outcome-selection penalty recurs in the same break data generator. Fresh seeds are independent simulations. The stable, iid and hidden regimes assess generality within the declared generator family.
